q: Is hail damage on my car covered?
a: Yes, if your motor policy includes partial cover (Teilkasko). Hail is a natural hazard covered under partial cover; the partial-cover deductible from your policy schedule applies.

q: What deductible applies when my windscreen is replaced?
a: The glass deductible stated in your policy schedule (CHF 0 or CHF 200), not the general partial-cover deductible.

q: Is my e-bike covered if it is stolen at the train station?
a: Only if your household policy includes the 'theft outside the home' add-on. You need a police report and proof of ownership.

q: How long do I have to report a claim?
a: Claims must be reported within 30 days of the incident. Later reports are not automatically rejected but are reviewed by an adjuster.

q: Do I need a police report for vandalism on my car?
a: Yes. Vandalism, theft and animal collisions require a police (or game-warden) confirmation.

q: Does my building insurance pay for a roof that leaks because the tiles are old?
a: No. Damage caused by wear and tear or lack of maintenance is excluded. Damage caused by a storm event is covered; mixed cases are assessed by an adjuster.

q: I damaged my car on a parking pillar. Is that covered?
a: Only with the collision module (Vollkasko). The collision deductible (CHF 1,000) applies.

q: What documents do I need after a burglary?
a: A police report, proof of ownership for the stolen items (receipts, photos or valuations) and a list of the stolen items with values.
